name: Le plus petit nombre unique
tagline: Choisissez le plus petit nombre que personne d'autre ne choisit : un jeu rapide.
description: Jouez au Plus petit nombre unique gratuitement : de 2 à 10 choisissent en secret, le plus petit nombre unique gagne la manche. Contre des bots, à plusieurs ou en ligne.
about: Lowest Unique Number is a quick party game of second-guessing for 2 to 10 players. Each round, everyone picks a number from 1 to 10 at the same time, in secret.

The lowest number that nobody else picked wins the round. Pick 1 and you win, unless someone else picked 1 too; then both of you are out of that round, and maybe a lone 3 wins. If every number was picked more than once, nobody scores.
Play 5 or 10 rounds; the most rounds won wins the game, and a tie is shared. Online, every pick is held on our server until all are in, so nobody can wait and see.
howToPlay: Choose 5 or 10 rounds, then Play vs bots, Play on this device, or create a room.
Each round, tap a number from 1 to 10. Your pick stays hidden until everyone has picked.
Then all the numbers are shown: the lowest one that only one player picked wins the round.
After the last round, the most rounds won wins.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a number.
Keyboard: Tab to a number; Enter or Space picks it.
tips: 1 is tempting, so it's often taken twice.
With more players, aim a little higher: the low numbers fill up.
Watch the history: people repeat what worked for them.
Don't always pick the same way, or you'll be read.

faq.question: Is it free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can others see my number first?
faq.answer: No. Online, every pick is held on our server until everyone has picked, then all are shown at once.

faq.question: What if nobody has a unique number?
How do the bots play?
faq.answer: Easy ones pick nearly at random; medium ones favour low numbers; hard ones learn how each player picks and play the odds.
